title: ""

---

## Core problem

What frequent remote-terminal task is blocked or unreliable today? Describe the
user problem without starting from a preferred implementation.

## Evidence

How often does this occur, who encounters it, and what concrete examples show
that it is more than a hypothetical convenience?

## Existing alternatives

Can OpenSSH configuration, HarmonyOS, the remote shell or another existing
HarmoTTY path solve it?

## Smallest solution

What is the smallest local change that resolves the problem without adding a
new permanent concept, setting, mode, dependency or state owner?

## Complexity

Which state, UI entry, dependency, protocol path or failure mode would the
proposal add?

## Product-principle fit

Explain how the proposal follows `docs/project-principles.md`.

> A proposal is an invitation to evaluate evidence. It is not a commitment to
> implement or merge the feature.
